title: Third-party licences: D-FINE, pytorch-grad-cam, RT-DETRv2 (extension)
criterion_preregistered: Each component is accepted if the LICENSE file shipped at the pinned version (git commit or PyPI release) is an OSI-approved permissive licence (Apache-2.0, MIT or BSD) that allows academic use, modification and redistribution with attribution. The licence is read from the actual file, not from badges or metadata, and its SHA-256 is recorded. Terms of pretrained weights and datasets are recorded separately and do not change the code verdict.

dfine.notes: Upstream README (commit 956d170) states that Objects365-trained checkpoints (*_obj365, *_obj2coco) may be subject to Objects365 dataset terms and are not cleared by the code licence. The default custom configs load ImageNet-pretrained PP-HGNetV2 backbone weights from github.com/Peterande/storage. Choice of initial weights is made in P3-06 and its terms are recorded there.

pytorch_grad_cam.notes: Copyright (c) 2021 Jacob Gildenblat. Text is identical to LICENSE on GitHub master @ 704393448a7b0c620ee2c2b9597723f1d7f17b3d (that copy has LF line endings, sha256 abbeae4bffb27ab9918e6b16207fe84de38577ac74c61a4a6f91dd20e9a6b7a3). PKG-INFO classifier: MIT License.

rtdetrv2.licence_file: LICENSE (repository root; rtdetrv2_pytorch/ has no separate licence)
